_comment: Committed a11y regression baseline for the post-deploy axe-core scan (test/a11y/axe.test.js).
_howItGates: Per page: the scan FAILS if a NEW rule id appears (not in this page's 'rules'), or if the 'critical'/'serious' violation count rises above the value here. Moderate/minor churn on already-known rules is reported but does NOT fail. A page not listed here defaults to zero-tolerance (any violation fails).
_howToUpdate: After intentionally fixing (or knowingly changing) a page, rewrite this file: A11Y_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 SMOKE_BASE_URL=<dev-approuter> npm run test:a11y. Ratchet the numbers DOWN; never raise them without review.
_capturedAgainst: dev approuter, WCAG 2.1 AA + best-practice tags
